column2: Do you have a smartphone that you can use during class?
column3: How is attendance usually taken in your classes?
column4: About how much class time is spent on taking attendance in one lecture?
column5: How often do you notice proxy attendance (someone marking attendance for an absent student) in your classes?
column6: Do you know your current attendance percentage in each subject?
column7: Have you ever been below or close to the 75% attendance requirement?
column8: On a normal day, how many hours do you study outside class?
column9: How do you currently plan or track your study time?
column10: How hard is it for you to stay focused while studying (for example, because of phone distractions)?
column11: How comfortable would you be if the app checked your location only at the moment you scan the attendance QR code?
column12: How interested would you be in one free app that marks attendance by scanning a QR code AND helps you track your study time?
column13: Which features would matter most to you? (Choose up to 3)
